pr_metadata.title: Feature - Allow serialize Enum object
pr_metadata.description:
## What type of PR is this? (check all applicable)

- Refactor
- Feature

## Description

This PR allows the _BaseSerializer to serialize and deserialize an Enum object.

gold_comments.issue_summary:
This `if` command handles the case where a dataclass instance is serialized into a dictionary.

For example, UserAttribute("email", "credential_mail", default="example@taipy.org") will be serialized to

```
{ "USER_ATTRIBUTE": {"name": "email", "credentials_name": "credentials_mail", "default": "example@taipy.org"}
```
The key is used to identify the type of the serialized object.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line `return _TemplateHandler._to_enum(actual_val)` references a method that is not defined or implemented in this diff, indicating missing deserialization logic for enums.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would flag this because the serialization path for enums is implemented but the corresponding deserialization path is incomplete, risking runtime errors when deserializing enum values from config.
